description:
Uptime monitoring over MCP. List and create checks, read results and incidents, and manage maintenance windows and status pages on a SolidPing instance.

SolidPing is open source (AGPL-3.0) and ships as a single Go binary. It runs 40 check types (HTTP, TCP, DNS, SSL expiry, ICMP, databases, brokers, headless-browser and JavaScript checks), checks from several regions, private agents for internal networks, public status pages and incident handling. Use it self-hosted or on solidping.io.

You need the URL of your instance and a Personal Access Token.
